title: Rav Chiyya bar Yehudah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Ketubot 21a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.21a.10-12), the third of three alternative attributions names Rav Chiyya bar Yehudah as the one who objected to Rav Yehudah: “Did Shmuel say so? But there was that document that came out of Mar Shmuel’s court…” Rav Yehudah answered: “That was an orphan’s document.” Hyman infers from this that Rav Chiyya still knew Shmuel and sat before Rav Yehudah.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1272&lang=en) give three alternative attributions for the question. The text does not itself say that the Rav Chiyya named in one version knew Shmuel personally.
